cards.name: Sunny, the Lemon Lynx
cards.flavor: Bright, impatient, and already halfway across the yard.

kitten.name: Sunny, Zesty Kit
kitten.text:
Exhaust: A unit you control gets +1 Power this round.
Grow Up: Your opponent has 5 or fewer Lives.

bigCat.name: Sunny, Sour Streak
bigCat.text: Exhaust: A unit you control gets +2 Power and Sneaky this round.

cards.name: Pippin, the Apple Ragdoll
cards.flavor: Flops over anywhere. Gets back up every time.

kitten.name: Pippin, Windfall Kit
kitten.text:
Exhaust: Heal 2 from a unit you control.
Grow Up: You have 6 or fewer Lives.

bigCat.name: Pippin, Orchard Keeper
bigCat.text: Exhaust: Heal 3 from a unit you control. It gains Guardian this round.

cards.name: Mochi, the Mango Bengal
cards.flavor: Lazes all morning. Rules all afternoon.

kitten.name: Mochi, Sunbeam Kit
kitten.text:
Exhaust: Ready one of your Treats.
Grow Up: You have 8 or more Treats.

bigCat.name: Mochi, Jungle Monarch
bigCat.text: Fierce. Exhaust: Ready two of your Treats.

cards.name: Zest Mouse
cards.text: Zoomies. Zest: gets +1 Power this round.
cards.flavor: Blink and it's already nibbled your rind.

cards.name: Tangerine Chick
cards.text: Goodbye: Deal 1 damage to a unit.
cards.flavor: Small, fluffy, and extremely petty.

cards.name: Lime Gecko
cards.text: Sneaky. Zest: gets +1 Power this round.
cards.flavor: The wall was green. So was the gecko.

cards.name: Orange Corgi
cards.text: Zest: enters ready.
cards.flavor: Short legs. Big plans.

cards.name: Grapefruit Ferret
cards.text: Zoomies. Zest: gets +1 Power this round.
cards.flavor: Sproing! Sproing! Sproing!

cards.name: Citron Fox
cards.text: Hello: Deal 1 damage to a unit. Zest: deal 2 instead.
cards.flavor: Always arrives with a little zing.

cards.name: Pomelo Ram
cards.text: Fierce.
cards.flavor: Headbutts first. Asks questions never.

cards.name: Yuzu Hawk
cards.text: Zoomies. Sneaky.
cards.flavor: It saw your Guardian. It didn't care.

cards.name: Sour Spray
cards.text: Pounce. Lucky. Deal 2 damage to a unit.
cards.flavor: Right in the eye. Every time.

cards.name: Zest Burst
cards.text: Deal 3 damage to a unit. Zest: deal 5 instead.
cards.flavor: Squeeze responsibly.

cards.name: Peel Out
cards.text: Ready a unit you control.
cards.flavor: Round two? Round two.

cards.name: Citrus Zester
cards.text: Attached unit gets +2 Power.
cards.flavor: Adds a little bite to anything.

cards.name: Clementine, Alley Sprinter
cards.text: Zoomies. Hello: Ready another unit you control.
cards.flavor: "Keep up, slowpokes!"

cards.name: Bergamot, the Whirlwind
cards.text: Hello: Deal 1 damage to each enemy unit.
cards.flavor: She doesn't enter a room. She happens to it.

cards.name: Sanguine, Blood Orange Panther
cards.text: Fierce. Once per round, after Sanguine defeats a unit in combat, ready her.
cards.flavor: Sweet on the outside. Ruthless within.

cards.name: Peach Bunny
cards.text: Hello: Heal 2 from a unit.
cards.flavor: Softest paws in the orchard.

cards.name: Pear Hedgehog
cards.text: Guardian.
cards.flavor: Hugs not recommended.

cards.name: Cherry Robin
cards.text: Ripen. Hello: If you control a Guardian, draw a card.
cards.flavor: Sings loudest when friends are near.

cards.name: Plum Mole
cards.text: Ripen.
cards.flavor: Digs a new tunnel under every tree. Just in case.

cards.name: Apricot Owl
cards.text: Hello: Exhaust an enemy unit.
cards.flavor: One stern look and everyone sits down.

cards.name: Apple Badger
cards.text: Guardian.
cards.flavor: This is its tree. You may admire it from over there.

cards.name: Quince Tortoise
cards.text: Guardian. Tough 1.
cards.flavor: Has been guarding this spot for ninety years.

cards.name: Fig Bear
cards.text: Guardian. Fierce.
cards.flavor: Big hugs. Bigger swipes.

cards.name: Hiss!
cards.text: Pounce. Cancel an attack. (The attacker stays exhausted.)
cards.flavor: The universal language of "no."

cards.name: Warm Cider
cards.text: Lucky. Heal 3 from a unit you control. Draw a card.
cards.flavor: Best served by the fire, with a blanket.

cards.name: Falling Apple
cards.text: Deal 4 damage to an exhausted unit.
cards.flavor: Gravity always picks a side.

cards.name: Apple Crate
cards.text: Attached unit gets +3 Health and Guardian.
cards.flavor: Every cat's favorite fort.

cards.name: Sakura, Cherry Blossom Siamese
cards.text: Once per round, when you heal 1 or more damage from a unit, draw a card.
cards.flavor: Every petal that falls, she remembers.

cards.name: Granny Smith, Orchard Matron
cards.text: Guardian. At the start of each round, heal 1 from each unit you control.
cards.flavor: "Sit. Eat. You look thin."

cards.name: Honeycrisp, the Gentle Giant
cards.text: Guardian. Tough 1.
cards.flavor: The whole orchard naps in his shadow.

cards.name: Pocket Hamster
cards.flavor: Fits in a pocket. Fights like a lion.

cards.name: Garden Snail
cards.text: Guardian. Lucky.
cards.flavor: Slow and steady holds the line.

cards.name: Mail Duck
cards.text: Hello: Draw a card.
cards.flavor: Neither rain nor snow nor grumpy cats.

cards.name: Catnip
cards.text: Pounce. A unit you control gets +2 Power this round.
cards.flavor: One sniff and anything is possible.

cards.name: Nap Time
cards.text: Lucky. Exhaust an enemy unit.
cards.flavor: Resistance is futile. Yawn.

cards.name: Banana Monkey
cards.text: Hello: Ready one of your Treats.
cards.flavor: Always has a snack to share.

cards.name: Kiwi Bird
cards.text: Hello: Sprout 1.
cards.flavor: Buries a seed wherever it naps.

cards.name: Passionfruit Parrot
cards.text: Zoomies.
cards.flavor: Arrives mid-sentence. Leaves mid-sentence.

cards.name: Pineapple Armadillo
cards.text: Guardian.
cards.flavor: Spiky on top. Stubborn all the way down.

cards.name: Lychee Sloth
cards.text: Can't attack unless you're Lush.
cards.flavor: Will get to it. Eventually.

cards.name: Guava Capybara
cards.text: Hello: Heal 2 from each unit you control.
cards.flavor: Everyone relaxes when the capybara arrives.

cards.name: Mangosteen Tapir
cards.text: Hello: If you're Lush, draw 2 cards.
cards.flavor: Snuffles up every fallen fruit.

cards.name: Jackfruit Elephant
cards.text: Guardian. Fierce.
cards.flavor: The jungle rearranges itself around her.

cards.name: Tropical Rain
cards.text: Sprout 2.
cards.flavor: Everything grows twice as fast after the rain.

cards.name: Coconut Drop
cards.text: Lucky. Deal 5 damage to a unit.
cards.flavor: Look up. Too late.

cards.name: Mango Smoothie
cards.text: Pounce. A unit you control gets +2 Power this round. Ready one of your Treats.
cards.flavor: Refreshing, and a little bit dangerous.

cards.name: Sun Hat
cards.text: Attached unit gets +2 Power and +2 Health.
cards.flavor: Very stylish. Very shady.

cards.name: Papaya, Beach Bum
cards.text: Hello: Sprout 1.
cards.flavor: "Tomorrow is also a beach day."

cards.name: Coconut, Island Guardian
cards.text: Guardian. Hello: Ready two of your Treats.
cards.flavor: Hard shell. Soft heart.

cards.name: Durian, the Mighty Stink
cards.text: Fierce. Sneaky.
cards.flavor: You smell her long before you see her. Then it's too late.

cards.name: Jam, the Strawberry Tabby
cards.flavor: Never alone. Never quiet.

kitten.name: Jam, Sticky Kit
kitten.text:
Exhaust, pay 1: Summon a 1/1 Seed Mouse token.
Grow Up: You control 5 or more units.

bigCat.name: Jam, Queen of the Patch
bigCat.text: Your Critters that cost 2 or less get +1 Power.

cards.name: Duchess, the Watermelon Persian
cards.flavor: She has not moved in three days. Neither have you.

kitten.name: Duchess, Pampered Kit
kitten.text:
Exhaust: Exhaust an enemy unit that costs 2 or less.
Grow Up: You have 10 or more cards in your Compost.
